title: Stamp Inverted Jenny, 500 CFA francs, WORLD’S MOST VALUABLE STAMPS
descriptionPlain: Description Reference to the historic 1918 airmail stamp Iconic motif recreated in pure silver Limited edition for collectors of rare themes Beginning of an extraordinary collection “ The World’s Most Valuable Stamps” The first airmail stamp in U.S. history and remains one of the most expensive and legendary printing errors ever — the airplane was mistakenly printed upside down. Today, this philatelic rarity continues to inspire collectors around the globe. Now reimagined as a silver coin, it captivates with its craftsmanship and symbolism — a tribute not only to a unique stamp but also to an era when the dream of flight was just beginning to take shape.
